title: IoT Architect
description:
**Kerala Vision Broadband Limited** 
 is seeking an experienced
 **IoT Architect** 
 to join our
 **Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Team** 
 and drive next\-generation IoT, Smart City, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Ernakulam / Thrissur
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 8–14 Years
 



 🏢
 **Department:** 
 Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Practice
   




 ◆ Role Overview
 
 The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist responsible for designing end\-to\-end IoT solutions across devices, connectivity, edge computing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As Kerala Vision expands its Managed Services \& System Integration (MSI) business, IoT is a key growth area covering Smart Cities, Industrial IoT, Smart Metering, Fleet Management, Healthcare IoT, and Building Management Systems.
 


 ◆ Key Responsibilities
 * Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures covering device, connectivity, edge, cloud, and application layers.
* Architect solutions using AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT, ThingsBoard, and similar platforms.
* Develop Smart City and Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for enterprise and government customers.
* Design IoT security frameworks including device identity, OTA updates, and secure communications.
* Support technical pre\-sales activities including customer presentations, solution proposals, BoQs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Leverage ISP connectivity assets such as NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, eSIM, and APN services to build innovative solutions.
* Engage with OEMs, technology partners, and industry stakeholders to deliver best\-in\-class IoT solutions.



  




 ◆ Educational Qualification
 
 🎓 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related disciplines.
 



 🎓 MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) with relevant industry experience may also be considered.
 



 🎓 M.Tech / MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.
 



  




 ◆ What We're Looking For
 
 ✔ Proven experience in designing and delivering end\-to\-end IoT solutions.
 



 ✔ Strong understanding of IoT connectivity, cloud platforms, edge computing, analytics, and security.
 



 ✔ Excellent customer\-facing, pre\-sales, and solution presentation skills.
 



 ✔ Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business\-focused solutions.
 



  





 📩 Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:
 



 careers@keralavisionisp.com

title: Technical Co-Founder And Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Guidzy is a travel technology platform focused on helping people explore India with faster, safer, and more personalized trip planning. The platform connects travelers with verified local guides, hotels, cabs, houseboats, activities, and authentic experiences through a single, trusted interface. Safety and trust are central, with features such as guide verification, ratings, reviews, location\-based matching, trip sharing, and SOS support. Starting in Kerala and expanding across India, Guidzy aims to build a nationwide local travel network that benefits both travelers and local businesses. Travelers of all types—solo, couples, families, groups, and international visitors—can use Guidzy to access reliable local support and truly “explore India like a local.”
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Co\-Founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead Guidzy’s technology vision, architecture, and product development from the ground up. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kerala, India, working closely with the founding team to build and scale a robust travel platform. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining technical strategy, overseeing system architecture, managing the development lifecycle, and ensuring platform performance, reliability, and security. The CTO will design and implement core product features, integrate third\-party services, establish development standards and processes, and build and mentor the engineering team. The role also involves collaborating with product, business, and operations teams to translate user needs into scalable solutions and iterate quickly based on market feedback.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret user behavior, product metrics, and technical trade\-offs, and to drive data\-informed decisions.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with founders, engineers, partners, and non\-technical stakeholders in a clear and inclusive manner.
* Sales\-related capabilities, including supporting product demos, engaging with early customers, and representing the technology vision in partner conversations.
* Marketing awareness to align product features with market needs, support go\-to\-market initiatives, and contribute to positioning and messaging for a tech audience.
* Research skills to stay current with travel\-tech trends, security best practices, and relevant tools, and to evaluate new technologies for platform growth.
* Proven experience designing and scaling web or mobile platforms (preferably marketplace or travel\-tech) using modern architectures and cloud infrastructure.
* Hands\-on expertise in backend and frontend development, APIs, databases, and performance optimization, with willingness to code in early stages.
* Experience building and leading engineering teams, setting development processes, and implementing QA, DevOps, and security standards.
* Ability to work on\-site in Kerala, India, and engage directly with local partners and users to understand ground\-level needs.
